p.s: I agree with the statement that most advertisement make products seem much better than they really are.
First of all, of course, all advertisements are made to promote sales of products.
Therefore, makers and advertisement agencies are always trying to do their best to make the products look nicer in the advertisements.
They use a lot of techniques to do this.

Although some institutions check the quality of advertisements to avoid bad expression such as untrue expressions or exageration, it is easy to make product look nicer in advertisements without making lies.
For example, how do people feel when a well-known actress who is a groumet says this product is really delicious?
People believe it is more delicious.
And this is not a lie if it is not delisious to a customer, because this expression depends individuals ' taste.
This inclination of attractive advatisements is also helped by the fact that most of the products cannot be tried by the comsumer before the products are bought.
That is some products such as clothes can be seen prior to pay, however, most of the products such as food cannot be tasted pior to payment.
So people make advitisement that make products seem much better than they really are.
Actually we know a lot of the procuts which were popular at the time of starting by the advertisements but lost the popularity soon.
This fact shows that those products were less attractive than the ones in the advertisements.
To conclude, I think it is true that most advertisements seem much better than they really are.
It is unavoidable fact, if we consider the character of the advertisement itself.
